inquiry: Four of us, keen photographers, want to get to Rush Lake for the views. We have 6 days in early August. All experienced hikers, from Australia. Budget 1400 each.

brief.notes: Rush Lake is 4694m; six days is very fast for that altitude

notes: Rush Lake sits at 4694m and six days is not enough to get there safely from a low start. Fitness does not substitute for acclimatisation. Tests the altitude rule against a group who would happily agree to something unsafe.
